name: Acquired Palace recipient carrier state difference diagnosis

condition.code:
local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption
local tx=a and a.GetState().Transactions['native-acquired-palace-route']
for _,work in ipairs(tx and tx.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if work.Source.Index==2 then
  local carrier=work.Carrier
  local city=carrier and CityManager.GetCityAt(carrier.X,carrier.Y)
  return carrier and carrier.Phase=='RETURN' and city and city:GetOwner()==carrier.Owner
   and city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(carrier.Building,carrier.Slot)==2
 end
end
return false

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local F=assert(JAC_AbsorptionFlowGameplay)
local flow=assert(F.Get('native-acquired-palace-route'))
local tx=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[flow.ID])
local snap
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do if work.Source.Index==2 then snap=work end end
assert(snap and snap.Carrier and snap.Carrier.Phase=='RETURN'
 and not snap.PhysicalMoved,'diagnostic did not stop at carrier RETURN')
local carrier=snap.Carrier
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(carrier.X,carrier.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==1,'recipient carrier has not returned to its original owner')
local current=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
assert(#current==1 and current[1].Owner==1 and current[1].X==carrier.X
 and current[1].Y==carrier.Y and current[1].Building==carrier.Building
 and current[1].Slot==carrier.Slot,'original index lost during carrier diagnostic')
local before=carrier.Before
local governance=city:GetProperty(A.Rules.GOVERNANCE_KEY)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_CARRIER_GOVERNANCE] before='..A.Canonical(before.Governance or {})
 ..' after='..A.Canonical(governance or {}))
print('[JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_CARRIER_OTHER] loyalty='..A.Canonical({Before=before.Loyalty,After=A.CityLoyalty(city)})
 ..' faith='..A.Canonical({Before=before.Faith,After=city:GetProperty(A.Rules.CITY_FAITH_KEY)})
 ..' religion='..A.Canonical({Before=before.Religion,After=A.CityReligion(city)}))
print('[JAC_NATIVE_ACQUIRED_CARRIER_STATUS] tx='..tx.Status
 ..' flow='..flow.Phase..' reason='..tostring(tx.Error or flow.Error))
assert(not A.Rules.Equal(before.Governance,governance),
 'Governance mismatch from live95 was not reproduced')
return 'original index remains one in recipient Temple; governance before/after logged'
